title: Trump announces Audi will build $4 billion factory in US state of Georgia
paragraphs: US President Donald Trump on Saturday announced that German car producer, Audi, will build a $4 billion (€3.77 billion) assembly plant in the US state of Georgia.
Speaking at a campaign rally in Perry, Georgia, Trump said the plant will produce 200,000 SUVs annually.
"Think of that. 200,000 cars a year. That's incredible," Trump said.
